about: Winthrop was founded in 2000 by John and Kay Sullivan, and the tree lighting was one of its earliest traditions, started before most buildings or homes existed.
For years the community tree stood in the Courtyard next to Cappy's Pizza, and in recent years it moved to Winthrop Common.

The Winthrop Pop Up Market organizes the vendor market, and the community stage lineup also includes Alder Music Studio, Collective Sound, Crane Artistic Creations and the Florida Academy of Performing Arts music showcase.
The tree lighting happens on the first Friday of December each year.

On Winthrop Common near the Mulberry Trees in Riverview, with the Holiday Market around the Common.
